English, Bahasa Malaysia, and Chinese interfaces

caseStudy.overview: F&N's ordering platform lets outlets and distributors order stock directly. As the primary developer at Flow Digital, I maintained the live React Native eOrder MY application and built the Flutter replacement, F&N GO. The replacement development period shown here is July 2024 to June 2025; legacy maintenance covered 2023–2024.

sections.title: A foundation for the whole product
sections.text: Defined the layered architecture and Riverpod state management, built typed domain models, and centralized API access. Carried the existing ordering and outlet-specific business rules into the replacement application.

sections.title: Ordering, promotions, and loyalty
sections.text: Delivered catalogue, cart, checkout, and order history, with FOC and purchase-with-purchase promotion rules. Built points balances, history, and expiry alongside voucher shopping, redemption, inventory, and checkout integration.

sections.title: Beyond the Flutter layer
sections.text: Integrated AWS Cognito authentication and device-integrity checks. Wrote Kotlin platform-channel code and Huawei messaging integration so push notifications could reach devices without Google Play Services, alongside Firebase messaging on GMS devices.

sections.title: Taking it into production
sections.text: Owned Android and iOS release work, signing configuration, versioned releases, update checks, and production/staging configuration. Delivered three interface languages and consistent offline, maintenance, and error states.

delivery: Released on Google Play and the Apple App Store
Primary developer across architecture, features, and release delivery

caseStudy.overview: Hicom-Teck See ALis digitises plant asset movements and approvals. I delivered the Flutter mobile client as sole developer and built the Laravel asset-management API used by both mobile and web.

sections.title: A shared approval engine
sections.text: Implemented the five-stage approval chain in Laravel so web and mobile use the same workflow rules. Supported asset loans, movement history, comments, notifications and role-based access.

sections.title: Tracking assets on the floor
sections.text: Built QR scanning and GPS check-in and check-out with photo evidence and activity history, providing an auditable trail for each asset movement.

sections.title: Replacing paper sign-offs
sections.text: Implemented e-signature capture, saved signatures and authorisation PDF generation. Added loan-extension requests with insurance-document review during post-launch development.

sections.title: Owning delivery and quality
sections.text: Delivered 43 screens across 8 Flutter modules and retained sole mobile ownership through post-launch releases. Expanded the mobile suite to 2,205 automated tests, supported by pre-push format, architecture and static-analysis checks.

delivery: Flutter mobile client and shared Laravel API
Five-stage digital approvals and asset movement history
2,205 mobile tests at the August 2026 evidence snapshot

caseStudy.overview: FlowHubr brings project, task and timesheet management to distributed teams. At Flow Digital Asia, I led the mobile team and owned architecture, code review and release engineering, alongside Laravel and Vue.js web contributions.

sections.title: Leading the mobile delivery
sections.text: Led a team of up to 6 developers and set the technical direction for the Flutter client. Owned architecture decisions, code review and Android and iOS release work.

sections.title: Migrating the architecture
sections.text: Re-platformed 13 feature modules from Riverpod to BLoC and Clean Architecture, separating presentation, domain rules and data access with typed API clients and dependency injection.

sections.title: Making quality measurable
sections.text: Built 1,319 automated tests and reached 88.3% line coverage against an enforced 85% CI floor. Added architecture checks, strict static analysis and generated-code freshness checks to support specification-driven, AI-assisted delivery.

sections.title: Connecting web and mobile
sections.text: Built the Laravel asset-management module and mobile REST API, including shared approval logic. Contributed feature tests and maintained companion Laravel and Vue.js workflows.

delivery: Shared Laravel API and asset-management workflows

projects.title: A stronger foundation.
projects.summary: Established a multi-tenant Laravel learning platform after analysing the incumbent .NET backend, with isolated tenant databases, automated provisioning and workspace permissions.
highlights: Legacy .NET domain and API analysis to scope the Laravel rebuild
Domain-Driven Design with separated application and infrastructure layers
Database-per-tenant isolation and automated workspace provisioning
Per-workspace role-based permissions and AWS deployment

caseStudy.overview: PEOPLEAPS and SKILL2U support SaaS learning workflows. I analysed the incumbent .NET system and established the Laravel backend architecture, with tenant isolation and workspace permissions designed into the foundation.

sections.title: Understanding the incumbent
sections.text: Scoped the rebuild against the existing .NET platform's 170 REST endpoints and 45 entities. This was legacy analysis and migration planning; I did not author the predecessor system.

sections.title: Separating domain responsibilities
sections.text: Established Domain-Driven Design layers to keep business rules separate from use-case orchestration and framework adapters. Supported learning, assessment, certification and integration workflows.

sections.title: Isolating each workspace
sections.text: Built database-per-tenant isolation and automated provisioning, including queued workspace setup and tenant-aware migrations.

sections.title: Permissions and operations
sections.text: Designed per-workspace role-based access, including role permissions and direct grants. Documented tenancy operations and supported AWS deployment for the learning platform.

delivery: Laravel rebuild scoped against the incumbent API and domain model
Isolated tenant databases with automated provisioning
Documented workspace permissions and tenancy operations
